document.title: test: harnesses for event queue, snapshot swap, hit testing, scroll math, upload single-flight
document.summary: Five new plain-C CTest harnesses cover the event queue, the snapshot swap under concurrent hit testing, hit testing with focus navigation, scroll math, and Runtime Upload Single-Flight. Two small extractions from `src/ui/input.c` make focus navigation and scroll momentum testable. Two side fixes correct the `jimp.h` path in `AGENTS.md` and make `agent-check.sh full` prefer `docker compose`.
document.why: Only a few CTest harnesses existed, and [the event queue, hit testing, focus navigation, scroll math and snapshot swap concurrency were untested](source:s1).

sources.title: Native test coverage: HTTP parsing, zip, package library, input, scroll
sources.gist: Add harnesses for untested pure modules, run them under sanitizers, and make a two-thread swap stress test possible.

sources.title: Use-after-free: instance_hit_test returns pointer into a snapshot that can be freed
sources.gist: Hit-test ids pointed into a snapshot the JS thread could free; asks for a harness that swaps while hit-testing under ASan.

sources.label: Orchestrator brief · Oct 25
sources.gist: Priority-ordered harness list, keep the diff under about 900 added lines, assert current event queue cap behaviour, and two side fixes.

lookFor: The brief asked for [roughly 900 added lines at most](source:s3); the diff adds about 1030, of which 78 in `src/ui/focus_nav.c` are moved, not new.

The brief asked to document whether the full event queue drops oldest or newest; `event_queue_harness` asserts the current drop-newest behaviour, and whether that is intended stays an open question for the owner.

parts.name: Native harnesses
parts.summary: New CTest harnesses plus the two extractions they need.

parts.name: Side fixes
parts.summary: A one-line doc path fix and a Docker Compose fallback in the agent check script.

groups.title: Event queue harness
groups.summary: `event_queue_harness` drives the real `event_queue.c` for FIFO order across the ring boundary, the 256 cap, clear, shutdown, and one concurrent producer, and `CMakeLists.txt` registers it with the other new harnesses.
lookFor: Pushing 300 events into an empty queue keeps events 0 to 255 and silently drops 256 to 299; the harness pins that, so changing to drop-oldest must update `test_full_queue_drops_newest`.

groups.title: Back-tree fixture
groups.why: It enables the snapshot swap and hit test harnesses, which build trees without QuickJS.
groups.summary: `tests/instance_fixture.h` creates, attaches, destroys and publishes back-tree instances the way `src/jslib/instance.c` does.

groups.title: Snapshot swap stress harness
groups.why: [#39](source:s2) asked for a harness that swaps snapshots while hit-testing under ASan.
groups.summary: The main thread mutates and swaps 20000 snapshots while a reader thread calls every front-snapshot accessor and checks the ids it copies out.
lookFor: Moving the `copy_id` in `instance_hit_test` after the unlock makes this harness fail under ASan with heap-use-after-free, so it does catch a #39 regression.

groups.title: Focus navigation extraction and hit test harness
groups.why: [Hit testing and focus navigation were untested](source:s1), and the D-pad target choice was a static function mixed with raylib input.
groups.summary: `focus_nav_pick` in `src/ui/focus_nav.c` takes over the scoring loop from `find_nearest_focusable` in `input.c`, and `hit_test_harness` checks it together with hit order, scroll offsets and focusable clipping on a tree built through the instance-tree API.
lookFor: Production code in a test PR: `find_nearest_focusable` now returns an index-based pick and calls `free_focusable_elements` on an empty list too, which is a no-op `arrfree(NULL)`; the scoring loop is moved verbatim.

groups.title: Scroll math extraction and harness
groups.why: [Scroll math and momentum were untested](source:s1), and the momentum step lived inside a function that reads raylib frame time.
groups.summary: `scroll_max_offset` and `scroll_momentum_step` in `scroll.c` replace inline math in `input.c`, and `scroll_math_harness` checks them with `scroll_flow_step` and `scroll_content_height`.
lookFor: Production code in a test PR: `touch_apply_momentum` still applies friction after the step, so a fling that lands exactly on offset 0 or the max still zeroes velocity before friction, as before.

groups.title: Runtime Upload Single-Flight harness
groups.why: The brief asked to prove a second ingest gets 409 and that staging is not shared.
groups.summary: The harness `#include`s `src/upload/http_server.c` to call the static `handle_upload` over socketpairs, holds one upload mid-body, and checks the second gets 409 without touching staging.
lookFor: The harness compiles `http_server.c` into itself, so its CMake target must not also list that file; a static rename in `http_server.c` breaks this harness at compile time.

groups.title: AGENTS.md path and docker compose fallback
groups.why: The brief asked for both while in these files: `AGENTS.md` named a `jimp.h` path that does not exist, and the Mac has only `docker compose`.
groups.summary: `AGENTS.md` points at `vendor/jimp/jimp.h`, and `run_vita` in `agent-check.sh` tries `docker compose` before `docker-compose`.
